# learn-duckdb

> An interactive, keyboard-driven SQL learning environment in your terminal powered by DuckDB and Textual.

learn-duckdb is a standalone, open-source terminal application designed for learning analytical SQL locally. It runs on top of DuckDB's in-memory engine, providing real-time query validation, sub-millisecond execution, syntax-highlighted editor with IntelliSense autocompletion, progress tracking, and an interactive data exploration sandbox.

## Quick Installation & Run

- Instant execution (zero install):
  ```bash
  uvx --from git+https://github.com/haydermuhib/learn-duckdb.git learn-duckdb
  ```
- macOS & Linux installer:
  ```bash
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haydermuhib/learn-duckdb/main/install.sh | bash
  ```
- Windows PowerShell installer:
  ```powershell
  irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haydermuhib/learn-duckdb/main/install.ps1 | iex
  ```
- Clone & run locally:
  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/haydermuhib/learn-duckdb.git
  cd learn-duckdb && uv run app.py
  ```

## Key Capabilities

- In-Memory DuckDB Engine: Every lecture executes in an isolated `:memory:` database with zero risk of corrupting source data.
- Result-Based Evaluation: Graded on actual output schema and returned records rather than rigid string matching, supporting all valid SQL dialects and aliases.
- SQL IntelliSense: Built-in autocompletion for SQL keywords, aggregation functions, window clauses, and live column names on `<Tab>`.
- Statement-Under-Cursor Execution: Press `<Ctrl+Enter>` to execute only the query under the cursor or selection, or `<Shift+Enter>` to execute the entire editor.
- Interactive Hint System: Accessible with `<F1>` (or `<Alt+H>`), with automatic proactive suggestions after repeated failed attempts.
- Sandbox & Data Playground: Freeform analytical playground where users can import local `.csv`, `.tsv`, or `.parquet` files directly into tables using `<Ctrl+I>`.
- ASCII Schema & ERD Generation: Press `<Ctrl+T>` to introspect tables, primary keys, foreign keys, and generate live ASCII Entity-Relationship diagrams.
- Progress Persistence: Automatically records completed tasks in `~/.local/share/learn-duckdb/progress.duckdb`.

## Curriculum

1. 01 SELECT Basics (8 exercises): Column projections, aliases (`AS`), arithmetic expressions, `COUNT(*)`, string concatenation (`||`).
2. 02 Filtering & Conditions (8 exercises): `WHERE`, `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, boolean columns, `IN`, `BETWEEN`, `LIKE` pattern matching.
3. 03 Sorting & Limits (8 exercises): `ORDER BY`, `ASC`/`DESC`, multi-column sorts, `LIMIT`, `OFFSET`, `NULLS FIRST`/`NULLS LAST`, `IS NULL`/`IS NOT NULL`.
4. 04 Real-World Challenges (8 exercises): Business analytics scenarios, transaction processing, conditional updates, multi-condition filtering.
5. 05 JOINs & Aggregations (8 exercises): `INNER JOIN`, `LEFT JOIN`, `RIGHT JOIN`, `FULL OUTER JOIN`, `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, aggregate functions (`SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN`, `MAX`).
6. 06 CTEs & Window Functions (8 exercises): Common Table Expressions (`WITH`), subqueries, `OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)`, `ROW_NUMBER()`, `RANK()`, `DENSE_RANK()`, `LAG()`, `LEAD()`.

## Keyboard Reference

- `Ctrl+J`: Execute entire editor SQL buffer
- `Ctrl+G`: Execute query or statement under cursor / selection
- `Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+V`: Copy / paste text in SQL editor
- `Tab`: Accept autocomplete IntelliSense suggestion
- `F1` (or `Alt+H`): Toggle task instruction hint
- `Ctrl+K` (or `Ctrl+Shift+P`): Open Command Palette
- `Ctrl+I`: Import custom CSV or Parquet file into Sandbox
- `Ctrl+B`: Toggle sidebar collapse / expand
- `Alt+Left` / `Alt+Right`: Resize sidebar width
- `Ctrl+N` / `Ctrl+P`: Advance to next / previous task
- `Ctrl+R`: Reset database state and task progress (with confirmation modal)
- `Ctrl+L`: Clear SQL editor buffer
- `Ctrl+T`: View ASCII Entity-Relationship Diagram (ERD)
- `Ctrl+Q`: Quit application

## Tech Stack & Architecture

- Language: Python 3.11+
- TUI Framework: Textual 3.0+
- Database: DuckDB 1.2+
- Formatting: Rich 13.0+
- Packaging: Hatchling / pyproject.toml
- Package Management: uv / uvx
